notes.title: Mass City Upgrade
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40887785/d93d42063a8f2ac8ee1e55a99b291983fbcfa973.png[/img]
Mega city simulation, complex traffic network, automobile traffic simulation, traffic light simulation, large-scale pedestrian simulation and day and night simulation are added.

The driving mode is added, and any vehicle on the roadside can be selected for driving.

By adding physical fragmentation simulation, cars and roadside objects can be damaged.

The rendering quality is improved. 8K texture and ultra-high precision model are used.

Optimized performance and fixed some bugs.
